# Saints Row PC - builds saintsrow.exe from the ReXGlue SDK, the code generated
# from your own copy of the game (see scripts/setup.ps1) and the sources in src/.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(saintsrow LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(DEFINED ENV{REXSDK})
    list(PREPEND CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH $ENV{REXSDK})
endif()
find_package(rexglue REQUIRED)

set(SR_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../build/generated" CACHE PATH
    "Directory containing the code generated by 'rexglue codegen'")
if(NOT EXISTS "${SR_GENERATED_DIR}/sources.cmake")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Generated code not found in ${SR_GENERATED_DIR}. Run setup.bat first.")
endif()

set(SAINTSROW_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/stubs.cpp
    ${REXGLUE_SHARE_DIR}/rex_app.cpp
)
if(EXISTS "${REXGLUE_SHARE_DIR}/windowed_app_main_sdl.cpp")
    list(APPEND SAINTSROW_SOURCES ${REXGLUE_SHARE_DIR}/windowed_app_main_sdl.cpp)
else()
    list(APPEND SAINTSROW_SOURCES ${REXGLUE_SHARE_DIR}/windowed_app_main_win.cpp)
endif()

include(${SR_GENERATED_DIR}/sources.cmake)
list(APPEND SAINTSROW_SOURCES ${GENERATED_SOURCES})

add_executable(saintsrow WIN32 ${SAINTSROW_SOURCES})

# rex_app.cpp expects REXGLUE_BUILD_CONFIG, which the SDK package doesn't export.
if(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    target_compile_definitions(saintsrow PRIVATE REXGLUE_BUILD_CONFIG="${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
else()
    target_compile_definitions(saintsrow PRIVATE REXGLUE_BUILD_CONFIG="Release")
endif()

target_compile_definitions(saintsrow PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

target_include_directories(saintsrow PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${SR_GENERATED_DIR}
)
target_link_libraries(saintsrow PRIVATE rex::runtime rex::gpu-xenos)

target_compile_options(saintsrow PRIVATE
    -fno-strict-aliasing
    -ffp-model=strict
    -fno-char8_t
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-O3>
    $<$<CONFIG:Release>:-DNDEBUG>
)
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(saintsrow PRIVATE -msse4.1)
endif()

# /force:multiple lets stubs.cpp override the SDK's kernel export implementations.
target_link_options(saintsrow PRIVATE "LINKER:/force:multiple" "LINKER:/STACK:16777216")

# Put the SDK's DLLs next to the exe so it also runs from the build folder.
add_custom_command(TARGET saintsrow POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_RUNTIME_DLLS:saintsrow> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:saintsrow>
    COMMAND_EXPAND_LISTS
)
